The tree farm is used to farm wood from your region. You are told to build 2 tree farms in the tutorial. A tree farm can harvest 2 wood every 5 seconds. Wood is a fairly cheap resource and does not yield much return. However, it yields the best ROI (return of investment) in all facilities(not counting land cost) at 3.6%/min.

Are you confused by the table on the right? You may want to read how it exactly works here. Some of the terms can confuse a decent chunk after all.

Building a Tree Farm[edit]

In order to build a tree farm, you will need to enter the command $$build tree farm (amount) Once you have entered the command, click the green checkmark under the message returned by the bot.
